translation.name: Godɨn Eghaghanim: Akar Gavgavir Dɨkɨrɨzir Ghurim ko Igiam

book.name: Onger Akaba
book.title: Godɨn Ziam Fer Onger Akabar Akɨnafarim O Onger Akaba

content.text: Ikiavɨra Itir God, uan Nguibam, uan mɨghsɨamɨn an ingari.
dar tongɨn, Ikiavɨra Itir God, Jerusalemra bar a gifonge.
Ia Godɨn Nguibamɨn aven itir gumazamiziba, ia deragh oragh,
God ghaze, nɨ nguibar bar aghuim.

content: (Ighiam gamua an suiamatugha avughsegha uaighiam gami.)

content.text: God ghaze, “Kɨ gumazamizir nan akam baragha an gɨn zuiba mengamin dughiamɨn,
kɨ uaghan Isipɨn kantrin gumazamiziba ko, Babilonɨn kantrin gumazamiziba ko, Filistian ikɨzim ko, Tairɨn nguibamɨn gumazamiziba ko, Itiopian kantrin gumazamiziba, kɨ uaghan bar me mengam.
Godɨn Bar Pɨn Itim, uabɨ Jerusalem asaragh, a damightɨ
Ikiavɨra Itir God, uabɨ Kantrin Igharazibar Gumazamizibar ziaba osirigh,
men ziaba isɨ Jerusalemɨn gumazamizibar ziaba sara me akuvagham.

content: (Ighiam gamua an suiamatugha avughsegha uaighiam gami.)

content.text: Jerusalemɨn itir gumazamiziba bar akuegh ighiaba bangam.
“O Jerusalem, bizir aghuir e itiba, nɨ bar dar mɨngarim.”
